preflight.note: Stamped before the public remediation evidence branch is committed; the initial containment actions are recorded in the incident evidence and no further implementation proceeds before review.

acceptance_criteria.text: The exact leaked commit is preserved in the private repository at the requested branch and SHA without force-push.
Only the leaked public branch ref is deleted, with public main and the intended public V1.3 ref unchanged.
All remaining public branches and tags are audited for private-marker reachability.
The leaked tree and reachable history receive a redacted credential scan with no live-secret candidates.
The installer, learner data, shared dirty checkout, and public main remain untouched.
An independent reviewer confirms the private recovery, public ref audit, and evidence safety before closeout.
